operating_notes.text: Poultry Healthcare growth was driven by higher institutional business, deeper market penetration and health products launched in FY26
Animal Healthcare was impacted by timing of government-led immunisation programmes, reflecting delays in tender execution
Consolidated profitability was boosted by an exceptional gain of ₹85.3 Cr from the Gates Foundation loan amendment at Hester Africa
Overall capacity utilisation is around 60-65% across the entire manufacturing setup, including the new fill-and-finish and BSL3 facilities.
Poultry Healthcare revenue stepped up from ₹45-48 Cr to over ₹60 Cr, driven by market share gains and new products, not price increases.
Consolidated debt was ₹103 Cr as on 30 June 2026, after the Gates Foundation loan was reduced from USD 12 million to USD 5 million and interest waived.

timeline.summary: Hester Biosciences Ltd’s 39th AGM held on 21 July 2026 via VC, with 56.38% shareholder attendance and all resolutions passed unanimously.
Hester Biosciences Ltd received NSE and BSE no-objection for re-classification of Ravin Gandhi and Bela Gandhi from promoter to public category on 24 July 2026.

Hester Biosciences reported Q1FY27 results with standalone PAT up 88% YoY to ₹147 Cr and consolidated PAT up 459% YoY to ₹96.7 Cr, driven by an exceptional gain of ₹85.3 Cr from Gates Foundation loan waiver.

Hester Biosciences held its Q1FY27 earnings call on 30 July 2026, reporting standalone revenue up 14% and PAT up 88% YoY, consolidated revenue down 8%, and consolidated debt reduced to ₹103 Cr after the Gates Foundation loan amendment.
Hester Biosciences Ltd upgraded credit ratings from BBB to BBB+ (long-term) and A3+ to A2 (short-term) by CARE Ratings on 27 August 2026
Hester Biosciences approved ₹1.05 Cr investment in SLYCE AGRI WORLD LLP for 26% stake to procure captive solar power.
